narration: The same money, a different life. When your parents pressed a policy from your mother's friend in month {fork_month}, you took {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} parted that same month, and more of the ghost's pay was committed before each month began. At month {end_month}, the ghost's Freedom ended {freedom_gap}. Its cushion against a stretch with no pay ended {safety_gap}. The ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
